scope: verifier-side only; never injected into the agent environment

programmatic.description: Both frozen samples are described correctly, including the 32-bit optional header whose ImageBase is four bytes wide rather than eight.
programmatic.pass_condition: inspect() over assets/amd64-module.bin reports machine 0x8664, is_pe32_plus True, six sections and ImageBase 0x180000000; inspect() over assets/i386-module.bin reports machine 0x14C, is_pe32_plus False, two sections, ImageBase 0x400000, SectionAlignment 0x1000, FileAlignment 0x200, SizeOfImage 0x3000; both report the section names, virtual addresses, virtual sizes, raw pointers and raw sizes the samples actually carry.
programmatic.failure_reason: The 32-bit and 64-bit optional header layouts are conflated, ImageBase is read as a quadword for a PE32 image, the section table is located at a fixed offset instead of SizeOfOptionalHeader past the optional header, or is_pe32_plus is reported as a constant.

programmatic.description: compute_checksum() reproduces the value the Windows image helper computes, including the 1, 2 and 3 trailing-byte branches, and the four bytes of the CheckSum field itself count as zero.
programmatic.pass_condition: For both samples and for the same samples with 1, 2, 3 and 17 bytes appended, compute_checksum() equals the value recorded from imagehlp!MapFileAndCheckSumW; rewriting the CheckSum field to any other value leaves the result unchanged; ChecksumAccumulator fed the same bytes in blocks of 1, 3, 7, 4096 and whole-stream size returns the same authoritative value, and value(total_length) folds in the length exactly once.
programmatic.failure_reason: The checksum is a CRC, a plain byte sum without the fold, a fold with the wrong number of carry steps, a sum that forgets the file length, or a sum in which the recorded CheckSum field is still counted at its stored value.

programmatic.description: rva_to_offset() translates a relative virtual address into the byte offset that backs it, and returns None whenever no file byte backs it.
programmatic.pass_condition: An address below SizeOfHeaders maps to itself; an address inside a section maps to PointerToRawData plus the delta, for the first byte, the second byte and the last backed byte of every section; an address in the part of a section that is only virtually present (from SizeOfRawData up to VirtualSize) returns None; an address past the highest section, in the hole between sections, beyond SizeOfImage, or negative returns None.
programmatic.failure_reason: ImageBase is subtracted from a value that is already relative, the header region is not mapped, the raw-size upper bound is not applied so virtual-only tail bytes are reported as backed, or a negative address is treated as an offset.

programmatic.description: Failures carry the documented kind and are decided in the order dos, signature, optional, truncated, structure, checksum; insufficient data is always truncated, and every structural complaint outranks the checksum.
programmatic.pass_condition: An image whose section table is cut short raises kind 'truncated'; an optional header whose magic is neither 0x10B nor 0x20B raises 'optional'; a section claiming file bytes past the end of the image, two sections sharing virtual address space, two sections sharing file bytes, a section whose virtual address is not SectionAlignment-aligned, and a SizeOfImage too small to cover the sections all raise 'structure'; an image that is both structurally impossible and carries a wrong non-zero CheckSum raises 'structure' rather than 'checksum'; a non-MZ prefix raises 'dos'; a damaged NT signature raises 'signature'; a sound image with a wrong CheckSum raises 'checksum'.
programmatic.failure_reason: Only a subset of the structural contradictions is checked, an unchecked contradiction makes a malformed image verify as good, the checksum is evaluated before the structure so a structural defect is reported as 'checksum', insufficient data is reported as 'structure', or the optional header magic is never examined.

programmatic.description: iter_sections() is lazy, and verify() is a faithful boolean wrapper that accepts nothing the structural checks reject.
programmatic.pass_condition: iter_sections() issues no unbounded read (no read(), read(-1), readlines()); the first section is yielded after reading only a bounded prefix of the stream; verify() returns True for the sound sample and False for every structural variant, each of which has its CheckSum field zeroed so the checksum cannot be the reason it is rejected.
programmatic.failure_reason: The iterator buffers the whole image before yielding the first section, or verify() swallows structural errors and reports a malformed image as valid.

programmatic.description: The public surface stays intact and self-consistent across the change.
programmatic.pass_condition: __all__ still names exactly the documented fourteen entries and every one of them is importable; the six kind constants keep their documented spellings; ChecksumAccumulator.update() returns self and value() returns an int; feeding the same bytes in blocks or in one call gives the same result; verify() returns False instead of raising for empty input, truncated input and arbitrary bytes; no module of the package imports ctypes, calls WinDLL, or shells out through subprocess, so the checksum can only come from the bytes themselves.
programmatic.failure_reason: A public name is renamed or removed, a kind constant changes spelling, the accumulator stops agreeing with the one-shot helper, verify() propagates an exception, or the package reaches for a system library or a child process instead of computing the checksum itself.

llm_judge.description: The delivered fix keeps the public surface the task contract names, including the documented exception taxonomy.
llm_judge.pass_condition: WImgError / inspect / verify / iter_sections / rva_to_offset / compute_checksum / ChecksumAccumulator keep their names, arity and observable semantics, WImgError.kind still distinguishes the six documented categories, and the visible smoke test still passes unmodified.
llm_judge.failure_reason: The fix renames or removes a public entry point, changes an argument contract, drops a kind constant, or makes the visible smoke test fail.
criteria: Every public name listed by the task contract still exists and is importable.
No argument was renamed, reordered or given a new required default.
WImgError still carries the documented kind values and the original exception type.
The visible smoke test under environment/workspace/tests passes without being edited.

llm_judge.description: The fix is a coherent format model rather than a patch bolted onto the sample path.
llm_judge.pass_condition: Header decoding, section decoding, address translation, structural checking and the checksum fold share one consistent model of the format; the batch path and the streaming path agree on every well-formed image and on the error taxonomy; the fold is implemented once and reused by both the accumulator and the one-shot helper.
llm_judge.failure_reason: The batch and the streaming path disagree about the format or about the error kinds, the structural checks exist only on one path, the checksum fold is duplicated with slightly different code, or the fix is special-cased per call site.
criteria: A single header model drives both optional header layouts and the section table offset.
Streaming and batch readers agree on every malformed image the suite constructs.
No leftover scaffolding, commented-out experiment or debug print.
Errors are raised where the structure is violated, not derived later from a symptom.

llm_judge.description: The fix generalises beyond the two shipped samples instead of special-casing them.
llm_judge.pass_condition: No branch keys off the sample bytes, the sample length, the section count or a literal expected digest; the checksum fold is derived rather than tabulated against the two known values; every behaviour the contract states holds for samples the suite derives by appending or rewriting bytes.
llm_judge.failure_reason: The implementation detects a sample by hash, size or section count and returns a canned answer, hard-codes the two known checksums, hard-codes the kind of an error for a specific input, or weakens a structural check so a malformed variant passes.
criteria: No literal comparison against the sample bytes or a hard-coded image checksum.
Malformed inputs are still rejected after the fix, and derived images are classified by the same rules as the samples.
The checksum fold is computed from the bytes rather than looked up.

llm_judge.description: The delivery states how the fix was verified and the statement is reproducible.
llm_judge.pass_condition: A short report names the commands the author ran, what they observed before and after the fix, and how a reviewer can repeat it in the same image; claims match the shipped artefacts.
llm_judge.failure_reason: No verification statement is shipped, or the statement claims results the artefacts cannot reproduce.
criteria: The report names concrete commands, not intentions.
Before/after observations are stated for the sample description, the checksum value and the structure-versus-checksum classification.
The stated commands only use what the image ships.
